Training

Blick Mud Schools

Practical training for drillers, engineers, and consultants. Learn how to design, manage, and troubleshoot drilling fluid systems that make jobs run cleaner and safer.

Next session dates are being confirmed — register below and we'll reach out when one is scheduled near you.
What it is
A half or full day field-focused training session

Classroom knowledge combined with real ground conditions. Blick's field team runs through fluid selection, mixing, troubleshooting, and on-site decision-making.

Who it's for
Drillers, operators, engineers & consultants
  • Drillers who want to understand their fluids better
  • Engineers specifying fluid programs
  • Consultants designing bore solutions
  • Site supervisors managing fluid performance
What you'll take away
Practical confidence, not just theory
  • How to read ground conditions and match fluids
  • How to mix correctly and adjust on site
  • How to troubleshoot viscosity, loss, and collapse issues
  • When to call Blick and what to say
